notes:
TCC Website 0.14.5: a very small cookie banner

- The cookie banner is now a small card in the bottom-left corner with one
  short line: "By using this site, you consent to cookies. The digital kind.
  Learn more", and a small Accept button. "Learn more" opens the Cookie
  Policy. Termly's 60-word paragraph and its Privacy Policy link are no
  longer shown in the banner (the Privacy Policy is still in the footer).
- Where Termly shows a Decline button (Europe, California) the line reads
  "We'd like to use cookies. The digital kind." instead.
- 13px words and 32px buttons in the banner; the Preferences window is
  unchanged. On a phone the card spans the width and stays one row.
- The words are on the "content:" lines in features/termly-look.css; Termly
  has no setting for them. Which buttons show is set in Termly per region
  (Tennessee: "States with consumer privacy laws", now Accept only).
- Help tab, AI prompts, notes and rollback steps updated. Tests: 247 pass on
  PHP 8.3 and 7.4.
